metadata.description: Real 4 x 4 km study area on the Yeongsan river plain in Naju-si, Jeollanam-do, western Korea: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 terrain, ESA WorldCover 2021 land cover, and OpenStreetMap roads. Selected for low relief and for a different Korean belt CRS from the Uljin bundle, to test whether this repository's handling of either is place-specific.
metadata.notes: The terrain is a DIGITAL SURFACE MODEL, so slope over vegetation is canopy slope (docs/FAILURE_MODES.md F-TER-3); on near-level ground that matters proportionally more than in Uljin, because a canopy step is a larger fraction of the true relief. Land cover is ESA WorldCover and is NOT a fire-behaviour fuel model; no crosswalk to one is shipped (docs/DECISIONS.md D-0024). WorldCover's 2021 vintage and its documented tendency to misclassify shadowed ground as water are recorded on the scheme. OSM rural completeness is UNKNOWN here as in Uljin, so egress counts inherit that limitation.
